item.title: Heritage Beats Rival NW Whitfield in Sweet 16
item.description: Ringgold, GA-(WDEF-TV) The Heritage girls basketball team beat rival NW Whitfield for the fourth time this season on Friday. T he Generals notched a 59-49 victory over the Bruins in the Sweet 16 round of the state tournament. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Dalton Cruises Into the Elite Eight
item.description: Dalton, GA (WDEF-TV) The Dalton girls basketball team had little trouble with Wayne Co in the Sweet 16 on Friday. The Catamounts led 10-2 after the first quarter on their way to a 63-28 victory. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Men’s Basketball Closes Regular Season With 86-79 Win Over VMI
item.description: GoMocs- The Chattanooga Mocs men’s basketball team closed out regular season play on the right note, claiming an 86-79 home win over VMI in the Southern Conference finale on Saturday afternoon inside McKenzie Arena as part of ‘Senior Day’ festivities. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Boyd Buchannan Final Four bound
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tennessee (WDEF)- Boyd jumped out to an early lead and held off a comeback attempt to advance to the Final Four. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
